# One Nextcloud major per line to EXCLUDE from the build matrix.
# Comments (lines starting with #) and blank lines are ignored.
#
# The build workflow fetches all currently-supported majors from upstream's
# `nextcloud/docker` versions.json and builds every one not listed here.
# When upstream releases a new major (e.g., 34), it will be built automatically
# unless added here.
#
# Example: drop NC 32 once you've migrated all consumers off it.
